question: Which comedy legend got caught on camera destroying his own speech?
story: Martin Short lost another Emmy on Sunday night, and the cameras caught him tearing his acceptance speech in half. According to E News, Parade and TV Insider, it happened at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on September fourteenth. Short was up for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series, for playing Oliver Putnam on Only Murders in the Building. The award went to Matthew Rhys, for Widow's Bay. And as Rhys walked toward the stage, the broadcast cut to Short, who reportedly ripped his speech into pieces and dropped it on the floor. Steve Martin posted a photo of the shredded paper afterward. Here is the part that made it spread everywhere. Short has now been nominated in that category for all five seasons of the show, and has never won once. Reports say the internet immediately started calling him the male Susan Lucci. Lucci lost eighteen times before she finally won. Short is only at five.
